name: Compute Cluster S40: Event Count Aggregation
description: Tests: Use Count aggregation on where-filtered series for event counting. Not Sum on 1/0 column.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S40: Event Count Aggregation
# Use Count aggregation on where-filtered series for event counting.
# Not Sum on 1/0 column.
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
ret = returns(close)

is_up = ret > 0
is_big_move = abs(ret) > 0.02

up_close = where(is_up, close)
big_move_close = where(is_big_move, close)

summary_table(
    title='Event Counts (Count agg on filtered)',
    category='Events',
    columns=TableSchema(columns=[
        ColumnSpec(name='Up Days', grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(name='Big Move Days', grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(name='Avg Up Return', grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
    ])
)(up_close, big_move_close, where(is_up, ret))
